title: sdk: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go + parity fixes and version bumps
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: unify small but important API surface differences between our Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs: auth configuration, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics. This reduces customer confusion, prevents regression windows when we change runtime behavior, and simplifies maintenance. Changes included in this PR:
- Standardize credential sources: support explicit token, env var, and default chain across all SDKs with the same precedence order and diagnostics.
- Unify retry policy API: introduce a RetryConfig proto-like canonical shape (max_attempts, backoff_base_ms, max_backoff_ms, retry_on) and wire it into client constructors.
- Streaming ergonomics: provide a consistent async iterator/async generator API in TS/Python and a channel-based iterator in Go; add convenience helpers for auto-reconnect and idle timeouts.
- Parity fixes: align request/response shapes for function-calling and tool-callbacks; fix edge-case where stream close code was ignored in TS SDK.
- Version bumps: python 1.71.0, typescript 1.71.0, go v1.71.0 with corresponding changelogs.
Implementation notes: this is primarily refactors across the three SDK subtrees plus small runtime-surface adapters in redwood to keep server compatibility. Most work is additive and non-breaking; migration notes are included below.
Checklist:
- [x] Update constructors and docs for Python/TS/Go
- [x] Add unit + integration tests for retry behavior across SDKs
- [x] Add streaming reconnection tests and CI harness job
- [x] Bump package versions and changelogs
- [x] Add migration notes in docs/sdk-migration.md
Related: Linear ENG-2145, ENG-2170. No customer-facing outage expected.
